_comment: SYNTHETIC fixture — assembled from public Spreed source, not captured from a real server. Verify against real traffic in Task 2.3. Represents the response of GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v3/signaling/settings?token={token} (SignalingController::getSettings, apiVersion restricted to v3). This is the canonical source of STUN/TURN config in internal-signaling mode (spec §5/§7 'STUN/TURN — берётся из capability сервера'). signalingMode='internal' means Talk itself is the signaling backend (no external HPB server) — that's the only mode the spec's P2P-mesh supports. Anonymized: STUN/TURN hosts -> stun.example.org / turn.example.org (RFC 2606 reserved); TURN credentials are dummy placeholders (REDACTED-TURN-AUTH); userId -> 'alice'; server -> empty (internal mode has no external signaling server).
_note_on_cloud_capabilities: The /ocs/v2.php/cloud/capabilities endpoint also exposes a 'spreed' section (capabilities like 'call-enabled', 'broadcast', 'sip-enabled', etc.) but it does NOT carry STUN/TURN — those live exclusively in /signaling/settings per Spreed source. If Task 2.3 discovers that the deployment of interest serves STUN/TURN via cloud capabilities instead, this fixture should be split in two.
